arguments.name: Showcase Asset Sheet
arguments.description: Turn design_muse directions for one asset into 3+ sprite variants rendered side by side in the Remotion AssetSheet, each citing borrowed reference properties and the cast property it sits between.

arguments.name: asset
arguments.description: The asset's job in the script's resource vocabulary (e.g. 'the human: resource_manager, the hands that place pieces').

arguments.name: context
arguments.description: The design_muse output for this asset (directions, reference set, capability contract).

arguments.name: files
arguments.description: Owned path for the variant components and the sheet scene.
